text:
zoe: Quick: were running a short social push for the "Inference Playbook" webinar next Tue. Need final copy for X + LI, platform-specific images, and a seedlist for SDR. Who wants scheduling?
rick: Ill take scheduling (Sprout). Proposed windows: primer 8:45am PT, main 10:40am PT, follow-up Wed 9:05am PT.
maya: Ill draft 4 copy variants: tease, ops-hook, metric-callout, and customer-angle. Share the one-pager and Ill align language.
leo: Creative will prepare landscape 1200x628, square 1080x1080, and a 6-slide PDF carousel for LI. Also a 3-frame GIF for X.
zoe: One-pager link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/inference_playbook_facts.pdf  key numbers: approx ~30% unit cost reduction, ~2x throughput at similar p99. Legal wants the word "approx" in front.
rick: Use UTMs: utm_source=x_tweet&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_playbook_jun2026&utm_content=postA. Ill append to the CTA.
maya: Draft snippets (rough):
- Tease: "Free playbook: scale LLM inference without surprises. Live Tue 11am PT  Register short.link/playbook"
- Ops-hook: "How we hit p99 SLOs while lowering cost. Demo Tue 11am PT"
- Metric-callout: "Approx. 2x throughput vs baseline and ~30% lower inference cost. Deep-dive Tue 11am PT"
- Customer-angle: "How Acme shipped a flaky assistant into prod. Join our live playbook Tue 11am PT"
leo: Uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood/marketing/inference_playbook_assets.zip. Includes alt-text per image and crop guidelines.
zoe: SDR routing: @sdr-bot please route registrants with utm_campaign=inference_playbook_jun2026 -> queue:webinar-nurture tag:social_ipb and owner_rotation:regional-sdrs.
sdr-bot: Confirmed. Routing rule created: utm_campaign=inference_playbook_jun2026 -> queue:webinar-nurture, tag:social_ipb, owner_rotation:regional-sdrs.
rick: Paid amplification ask from growth: $900 for benchmark-led post. Recommend $600 on X, $300 reserved for Wed follow-up. Agree?
maya: Yes prioritize the metric-callout post for paid. Ill make a pinned reply copy for X with a TL;DR + CTA.
leo: Ill add accessibility alt-text and ensure the LI carousel first slide is a strong TL;DR.
zoe: Legal: @olivia (cc) please review the copy once I flag drafts. Need a quick turnaround EOD Mon.
zoe: Scheduling checklist for @rick: final copy per channel, creatives per crop, CTA short.link/playbook, UTM string, paid tags, and legal approval flag.
rick: Ill queue drafts by Mon 3pm PT and tag "needs:legal". Will publish after sign-off.
maya: Ill drop final copy into Sprout comments and include alt-text + micro-CTAs for each platform.
zoe: Thanks team. Quick sync Mon 4pm PT to confirm paid creative and landing page snippet. :rocket:
